title: Movies with their director
statementMd:
List each movie title with its director's name (movies without a director are not shown).

Expected columns: `title`, `director`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, d.name AS director FROM movies m JOIN directors d ON d.id = m.director_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
